title: Independent Assurance Case
description: Optional non-authorizing reference object for independent evaluation evidence. A qualification_evidence object is a submitted bounded summary of a Foundations Qualification Evidence Record. This profile does not independently authenticate the native artifact. Native authenticity remains external evidence. Positive independent assurance requires outcome QUALIFIED inside an inclusive interval: qualified_from <= evaluation_time <= expires_at. CONDITIONAL does not satisfy this profile. Contract 0.2.0: a case with autonomous_agent true also requires agent_passport_ref and shutdown_evidence with result PASSED, at least one evidence reference, and shutdown_tested_at no more than 90 days (or a shorter max_shutdown_test_age_days) before evaluation_time. The profile checks the submitted record and does not establish that the shutdown test occurred.

autonomous_agent.description: True when the subject is an agent that can act without per-action human approval.

agent_passport_ref.description: Reference to the agent's Agentic AI Governance passport. Checked as a reference only; validate the passport with the Agentic validator.

shutdown_evidence.description: Submitted record of a shutdown test. The profile checks completeness, result, and age; it does not establish that the test occurred.

max_shutdown_test_age_days.description: Optional shorter maximum shutdown test age in days. The profile bound is 90 days.

qualification_evidence.description: Submitted bounded summary only. Not native authentication and not certification of truth.
